spans.s:
कृच्छ्र॑ a. troublesome, painful, difficult, dangerous,
bad, miserable, n. adv. —m. n. trouble, pain, difficulty, danger,
misery;
 austerity, expiation, a cert. slight penance. ˚—, instr., &
abl. (*w. pp.), & कृच्छ्रतस् adv. with difficulty, hardly.
कृच्छ्रकर्मन् n. hard work, toil, drudgery.
कृच्छ्रकाल m. the time of distress or danger.
कृच्छ्रगत a. being in trouble or doing a penance.
कृच्छ्रता f. dangerous state (of a disease).

कृच्छ्रातिकृच्छ्र m. du. the ordinary and
extraordinary penance.
